whatIs: Responsively App is a free, open source desktop app that shows your site at several device sizes at the same time. Clicks, scrolling and navigation are mirrored across all the views.
It's a good fit when you're developing a responsive design and want to see changes on all screens at once, without resizing the window.
uses: Checking a landing page on mobile, tablet and desktop while you build it.
Saving device combinations with Preview Suits so you can go back to them in another project.
Taking full-page screenshots on all devices at once.
caveats: Its license is AGPL-3.0, something to consider if you plan to modify and redistribute the code.
It's a separate desktop app, not an extension for your usual browser.
The latest stable version is 1.18.0, from February 2026; 2.0 has been in beta since September.
pricingNote: Free and open source under the AGPL-3.0 license.
idealFor: Front-end developers who test designs on several devices at once.
